sentence: The Eatwell Guide shows the proportions of food groups in a balanced UK diet, with fruit, vegetables and starchy foods making up just over a third each.
note: Guide: fruit and vegetables just over a third; starchy foods just over a third

sentence: The NHS Eatwell Guide divides food into groups and shows how much of each makes up a balanced diet.

sentence: Fruit and vegetables and starchy foods each make up just over a third of the guide, with higher-fibre starchy choices preferred.
note: Fruit and veg just over a third; starchy just over a third, higher-fibre preferred

sentence: NHS advice is at least five portions of a variety of fruit and vegetables a day, and at least two portions of fish a week, one of them oily.
note: 5 portions of fruit and veg; 2 portions of fish a week including 1 oily

sentence: Foods high in fat, salt and sugar sit outside the main groups and are meant to be eaten less often and in small amounts.

sentence: The Eatwell Guide is the UK government's picture of a balanced diet, and the NHS explains it on its Live Well pages.
note: NHS Eatwell Guide page; GOV.UK Eatwell Guide booklet

sentence: It divides the foods people eat into groups and shows roughly what share of the diet each should make up.
note: Guide divides food into five groups

sentence: Foods and drinks high in fat, salt and sugar sit outside the main groups, and the guide says they should be eaten less often and in small amounts.
note: Foods high in fat, salt and sugar outside the guide; less often, small amounts

sentence: Fruit and vegetables make up just over a third of the food in the guide.
note: Fruit and vegetables just over a third of food we eat each day

sentence: The NHS advises at least five portions of a variety of fruit and vegetables a day.
note: Eat at least 5 portions of a variety of fruit and veg every day

sentence: A portion of fresh, canned or frozen fruit or vegetables is 80 grams.
note: A portion of fresh, canned or frozen is 80g

sentence: Starchy foods also make up just over a third of the guide, and the NHS recommends choosing wholegrain or higher-fibre versions where possible.

sentence: The guide includes beans, pulses, fish, eggs and meat as protein sources, with fish given particular mention.

sentence: The NHS advises at least two portions of fish a week, including at least one portion of oily fish.
note: At least 2 portions of fish a week, 1 of which oily

sentence: For dairy and alternatives the guide points to lower-fat and lower-sugar choices where possible.

sentence: Unsaturated oils and spreads are the choice for oils, eaten in small amounts.

sentence: NHS healthy eating advice names saturated fat, free sugars and salt as the main things to keep in check.
note: 8 tips: saturated fat, sugar, salt

sentence: Fruit juice and smoothies are limited to a total of 150 millilitres a day, because they are high in sugar.
note: NHS limits juices and smoothies to 150ml a day, ideally with a meal

sentence: The NHS says sugary drinks can be swapped for diet, sugar-free or no-added-sugar versions.
note: Swap sugary drinks for diet, sugar-free or no added sugar

sentence: The NHS tips say that balancing the energy taken in from food and drink with the energy used through activity is the key to a healthy weight.

sentence: They describe a breakfast high in fibre and low in fat, sugar and salt as one way to be part of a balanced diet.
note: Healthy breakfast high in fibre and low in fat, sugar and salt

sentence: The NHS advises adults and children aged 11 and over to have no more than 6 grams of salt a day, and younger children less.

sentence: It says about three quarters of the salt people eat comes from packaged foods, which is why labels matter.

sentence: Salt is linked to high blood pressure, which can lead to heart disease or stroke.
note: Salt is linked to high blood pressure, which can lead to heart disease or stroke

sentence: Too much saturated fat can increase cholesterol in the blood and so the risk of heart disease, and the NHS suggests swapping towards unsaturated fats such as vegetable oils, oily fish and avocados.

sentence: UK nutrition labels show energy, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, sugars, protein and salt.

sentence: Front-of-pack labels use red, amber and green colours to show whether a food is high, medium or low in fat, saturated fat, sugars and salt.
